title: Vitalik Buterin Calls for Scrapping Ethereum’s ‘Most ZK-Unfriendly’ Feature
summary: Vitalik Buterin advocates scrapping Ethereum's modular exponentiation precompile, a feature he originally designed, as it creates verification bottlenecks up to 50 times worse than standard operations in zero-knowledge proof generation. The post Vitalik Buterin Calls for Scrapping Ethereum’s ‘Most ZK-Unfriendly’ Feature appeared first on Cryptonews .
